display.purpose: Per-currency month totals; the loudest text on screen.

title.purpose: Bold list amounts and card section headings.

body.purpose: Table rows and general reading; form inputs at 0.95rem.

label.purpose: Table headers, form labels, currency labels, buttons (1rem), link-buttons (0.85rem).

shadows.name: whisper
shadows.purpose: The only shadow token; separates cards from the paper ground.

shadows.name: whisper-reverse
shadows.purpose: The mobile bottom bar lifting off the ground.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Navigation swaps to the fixed bottom bar, form goes single-column, tables scroll horizontally, all targets grow to 44px/16px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one actionable button: Guardar. Action green, white text, 8px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--action, #0e7a3d); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--action-hover, #0b6634); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #0e7a3d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #d9d5cc; color: #595959; cursor: default; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive intent (Borrar). Compact, danger red, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: var(--danger, #b3261e); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.8rem; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; } .ds-btn-danger:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #8f1c16; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #0e7a3d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }

components.name: Action Link Button
components.description: Underlined text button. Green when it performs an action (Renombrar, Restaurar); muted when it navigates or cancels.
components.css: .ds-btn-link { background: none; border: none; color: var(--action, #0e7a3d); text-decoration: underline; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 0; min-height: 44px; } .ds-btn-link:hover { color: var(--action-hover, #0b6634); } .ds-btn-link-muted { color: var(--muted-text, #595959); } .ds-btn-link-muted:hover { color: var(--ink, #1a1815); } .ds-btn-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #0e7a3d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Card-white field with hairline border, 8px radius; label stacked above at 0.8rem muted.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--muted-text, #595959); font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; } .ds-input { padding: 0.45rem; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #e8e4dc); border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.95rem; background: var(--card, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #1a1815); min-height: 44px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #0e7a3d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-text, #595959); }

components.name: Status Chip: OK
components.description: Positive state pill: ink on gray-green tint. Never the action green.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-size: 0.75rem; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-ok { background: var(--ok-bg, #eef2ee); color: var(--ink, #1a1815); }

components.name: Status Chip: Danger / Warn
components.description: Status pills: over-budget/VENCIDO in danger red on danger tint; REFERENCIA ANTIGUA in amber on amber tint.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-size: 0.75rem; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-danger { background: var(--danger-bg, #fdecea); color: var(--danger, #b3261e); } .ds-chip-warn { background: var(--warn-bg, #fff4e5); color: var(--warn, #b45309); }

components.name: Card
components.description: White card on warm paper: 12px radius, hairline border, whisper shadow, 1rem padding.
components.html:
Total del mes
ARS$ 1.234,50
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #e8e4dc); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(26, 24, 21, 0.06); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted-text, #595959); margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-total { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-total-currency { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--muted-text, #595959); } .ds-total-amount { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #1a1815); }

components.name: Navigation Tab
components.description: Underline tab: muted at rest, ink on hover; active = ink 700 with 2px ink underline (a state, never green).
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-tab { border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-text, #595959); padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.95rem; min-height: 44px; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #1a1815); } .ds-tab-active { color: var(--ink, #1a1815); font-weight: 700; border-bottom-color: var(--ink, #1a1815); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action, #0e7a3d); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The world is a calm warm-paper workspace: a near-black warm ink on a light paper ground (#f7f5f0) with white cards floating on it, quiet hairlines instead of loud table grids, and a single saturated green that is reserved for the moment of action. The old navy/white dashboard look is the declared anti-reference — this world refuses the generic dashboard table sea.

Loudness is managed, not flat: numbers scale up by role (month totals the largest, list amounts next, meta smallest) and every amount sits on tabular figures so columns of money align like a ledger. Status never borrows the action hue: freshness and budget health live in small uppercase pills on tinted grounds. On phones the navigation drops to a fixed bottom bar at thumb reach, and destructive choices confirm inline in the row rather than in a modal.
keyCharacteristics: Money is the loudest thing: tabular figures on every amount, bold at list level, largest at totals.
ONE saturated green; it appears only where something can be done.
State lives in chips: pill badges carry over-budget, freshness, and reference-age status.
Warm paper ground, white cards, warm near-black ink; calm light theme for day and night scanning.
Flat depth: hairline borders plus a whisper shadow; nothing ever lifts on hover.
Bottom-bar navigation at thumb reach on phones (≤640px).

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: The action green is the only saturated accent in the system, and it means one thing: something can be done here. It is never used for status (the OK chip is ink on gray-green), never for location (active nav is ink, not green), and never for disabled controls (gray-warm instead). On the first viewport it appears on Guardar only.

rules.name: The State-in-Chips Rule
rules.body: Status is never painted with the action hue. Budget health, freshness, and reference age live in small uppercase pills on tinted grounds: red for over-budget or VENCIDO, amber for REFERENCIA ANTIGUA, ink-on-gray-green for OK.

rules.name: The Active-Is-Ink Rule
rules.body: The current navigation location is bold ink with a 2px ink underline (bottom-border on desktop tabs, top-border on the mobile bar) — a state, not an action. Green marks what you CAN do, ink marks where you ARE.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every rendered amount — totals, row amounts, indicator values, the live conversion preview — is set with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Columns of money must align; digits never wobble.

rules.name: The Loudness Ladder Rule
rules.body: Money loudness is fixed by role, not by context: totals (1.5rem/700) > indicator values (1.35rem/600) > row amounts (1rem/600) > quiet meta (0.8rem muted). Supporting text never outshouts the number it supports.

rules.name: The Whisper-Only Rule
rules.body: One shadow token, one depth step. Elevation never grows on hover, and a surface is never more than one hairlined step off the paper.

dos: Do set every amount in tabular figures, bold at list level (1rem/600) and largest at totals (1.5rem/700).
Do reserve the action green for actionable elements only — on the first viewport, Guardar is its only home.
Do express status in pills: tinted grounds, uppercase 600 text, ink for OK.
Do mark the active navigation location in bold ink with a 2px ink underline.
Do keep cards flat: hairline border, Whisper shadow, 12px radius, 1rem padding.
Do keep touch targets at 44px and mobile inputs at 16px.
Do keep the warm light ground (#f7f5f0); the old navy/white look is the anti-reference.
donts: Don't use the action green for status, location, or disabled controls — it means "something can be done" and nothing else.
Don't introduce a second saturated accent; the palette is one green, one red, one amber on warm paper.
Don't let money lose its tabular alignment, and don't let supporting text outshout the number it supports.
Don't darken or elevate surfaces for depth — paper and card are the only two steps.
Don't drop the calm light theme for a dark or navy treatment; the world is paper, ink, and one green.
